findings.title: Readiness proximity and human-readable permission visibility can falsely pass
findings.evidence: real-electron-flow.mjs:509-511,568-570,706-710. The only distance condition is readiness.bottom <= composer.y + 2. There is no maximum gap; clipFor(...).rect truthiness accepts any positive sliver, and no permission/blocker text-line visibility or occlusion check is recorded. The optional blocker query is inside readiness even though the existing composer-access-note is a composer descendant in the Mu branch.
findings.static_counterexample: Starting from revision11-purechecks base(), move readiness to y=0,height=40, leaving composer.y=540 and readiness_visible/permission_visible true. All relevant conditions still pass although the notice is 500px from the composer. A permission box with only a 1px clipped strip similarly produces permission_visible=true while its human-readable reason may be offscreen.
findings.minimum_fix: Measure actual readonly status and visible permission summary/reason nodes, retain their ancestor clips, and enforce an explicit reviewed maximum gap plus readable visibility/occlusion at the initial viewport. Locate any applicable composer blocker in its actual container. Add far-away, clipped-text and occluded-notice pure negatives; do not fabricate a permission state.

findings.title: Context/activity acceptance and fresh empty-state observation are incomplete
findings.evidence: real-electron-flow.mjs:503,555-577,671-674,689-691 only records context rect/text and requires its existence. It never checks context/activity clipping, meaningful empty state, history record count or actual activity entries. Both task_record_count selectors scope harness-run-progress to conversation-pane, whereas freeze03 workbench.jsx:521 renders HarnessRunProgress inside the context pane; task history is at line 506 and ActivityRail at line 522.
findings.impact: A hidden or oversized context pane and unintended context activity can escape the new gates. This is a verifier coverage defect, not evidence that the current product actually fabricates any Task or event. Existing conversation-message detection still catches the ordinary selected-task path.
findings.minimum_fix: Observe the actual context/activity/history locations; require the expected fresh empty state and absence of actual Task/progress/activity records across the full assistant layout. Check desktop context visibility/compact layout and mobile context reachability through the real scroll container, without requiring the entire mobile context to occupy the first screen or injecting fake events.

findings.title: Long draft and keyboard-area geometry are not exercised
findings.evidence: real-electron-flow.mjs:591 has only the two normal viewport sizes. Lines 634-649 fill one short sentence and issue Shift+Enter once. There is no long/multiline draft, textarea scroll/resize/caret reachability measurement, reduced-height keyboard-area scenario or post-edit geometry measurement. The mobile safe-area finding at 713-715 only compares static bottom-nav rectangles. prepare10 also lacked these interactions; this is unmet requested coverage, not a removed historical test.
findings.minimum_fix: Add a bounded long multiline draft case and a separately labelled reduced-height mobile viewport diagnostic, checking textarea focus, draft preservation, scrolling and composer/nav clipping in the real UI. Do not call a desktop viewport resize proof of an actual mobile OS keyboard. Keep all interactions zero-submit and do not send plain Enter when it can submit.

findings.title: Source-pin cardinality does not enforce the complete final UI set
findings.evidence: real-electron-flow.mjs:17-21,227-247 requires >=48 unique path strings and six mandatory selector files. It does not require activity.js, components/harness-run-progress.jsx, components/activity-rail.jsx, style.css or components/app-shell.jsx. These own append/keyboard semantics, permission/activity rendering and root/nav layout. Their omission can be masked by unrelated valid pins while satisfying the count.
findings.minimum_fix: Use Root's final reviewed complete source selection as an explicit required membership set (or a pinned selection manifest with exact set equality), including all imported geometry/interaction owners. Retain null final HEAD/bundle binding until build14 exists. The review marker alone must not substitute for the full pin set.

findings.title: Suggestion check can lose the latest edited draft suffix
findings.evidence: real-electron-flow.mjs:646-648 validates shiftedDraft exactly but compares appendedDraft only against originalDraft, not shiftedDraft. An append handler dropping the just-inserted newline still passes. Current activity.js:43-44 preserves the entire nonempty draft verbatim before adding two newlines and the suggestion.
findings.minimum_fix: Compare the resulting value against the actual pre-click shiftedDraft and the reviewed appendPrompt semantics; record focus after the suggestion as well. Add a negative case dropping or replacing a draft suffix.
